headline: CAT Stock Downgrade On Data Center Moratorium Hamstrings Dow Jones Industrial Futures
summary: Caterpillar's strong order and backlog growth are likely to slow in 2027 and 2028, Baird projected on Wednesday, highlighting the recent New York data center moratorium as an example of growing state and local regulatory pushback.  CAT stock dragged the Dow Jones into the red before Wednesday's open, as S&P 500 futures pointed higher.  Baird downgraded CAT to neutral from outperform, cutting its price target to 900 from 1,200, according to The Fly investment news site.
